Sealed as 324 present / 59 blank / 11 absent = 394.

reseal_history.reason: Catalog instruction (config/cds/domains/financial_aid.yaml, all twelve h14_* metrics): 'a blank cell in this or any other visible H14 coordinate is not_reported, never false, and must not be inferred from another cell.' Three independent adjudications (Caltech at original seal time, plus fresh UGA and UCF re-adjudications) all ruled: a visibly-present but unticked H14 checkbox is `blank` with no value -- never `present`/`false`.

class_size.class_sections_50_99.evidence: UCF's printed I3 table does NOT have a '50-99' row label. Its band sequence is 2-9, 10-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 100+ (seven bands total, no 60-99 band exists anywhere). Row printed as '50 - 59' = 372's neighbor 416, immediately followed by '100 +' = 318. Recorded the '50-59' row's value (416) as the closest positional match to this metric since it is the only band between 40-49 and 100+, but the document's own band boundary (59, not 99) does not match the metric's '50-99' definition. Sum check: 372+550+701+468+346+416+318 = 3171, which equals the printed Total (3171) exactly, confirming these are the complete set of bands UCF reports (no separate 60-99 band is hidden or missing) -- UCF's document genuinely uses a narrower top-of-midrange cutoff than the standard CDS '50-99' band.
